title: Text: DET Brian Britten ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Do you have Venmo? I owe you $165 minus the $60 entry fee for winning football. So, it would be $105.
What are the payouts, I was looking for them

Here’s how it all breaks down... $600 in from the 10 teams $150 for the website is subtracted. So, that leaves $165 to the playoff winner and $165 to the points winner. $60 goes to the playoff runner up and point runner up. So, I owe you $105 since you hadn’t paid the $60 yet. I’ll just deduct the $60 from the winnings are owed which gets it to $105. That all make sense?
